name: How can I set a realistic budget for my interior renovation?
description: Budgeting requires researching costs, factoring in materials and labor, and including a contingency fund, ideally 10-15% for unforeseen expenses.

mainEntity.name: How can I set a realistic budget for my interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Setting a realistic budget for your interior renovation involves researching typical costs for similar projects, accounting for materials, labor, and potential unforeseen expenses. It's advisable to allocate 10-15% of your budget for contingencies. Discussing your financial parameters early in the planning stage allows us to recommend design options and material selections that align with your budget. We can also provide value engineering suggestions to optimize costs without compromising quality.
